name: The Absent Minded Prospector
label: Quest
description: This errand delivers a strange petrified specimen recovered from the wild beaches of Darkshore to the Explorers' League outpost in Darnassus.…
intro: This errand delivers a strange petrified specimen recovered from the wild beaches of Darkshore to the Explorers' League outpost in Darnassus. Archaeologist Hollee refuses to abandon her distracted colleague in the field, entrusting the specimen's transport to a passing adventurer instead. The fossil's arrival in the night elven capital immediately captures the keen interest of Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So the prospector wants to send the mysterious fossil to the Explorers' League in Darnassus? I don't feel right leaving Darkshore without him.
Here, friend, deliver the mysterious fossil to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What can I do for you, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh my! Leave it to Prospector Remtravel to discover such a find!
